comment: Layer/datatype map + DRC constants for the CDAC array generator. The layout_<pdk>_array.py files must read this via layers.py instead of hardcoding (layer,datatype) pairs and um rules.

rules_um.comment: ihp: cap pitch = cell width (nwells merge edge-to-edge); row pitch clears NW.b1/NBL.c (>1.6 um nwell gap).  The TG/cap cells are MOS-based so there is no separate metal fringe cap here.

momcap.note: lateral fringe; values are the *real* sg13g2 DRC minima (M1.a=0.16 w, M1.b=0.18 s, Mn.a=0.20 w, Mn.b=0.21 s).  Both M1 and M2 fingers use the widest limit so the same comb is clean on both layers.
